description: Required-controls catalogue keyed by risk tier. When a system is classified, the controls whose `applies_to` includes its tier are instantiated as a checklist (initial status MISSING).

controls.title: Cease or do not deploy
controls.description: Prohibited AI practices may not be placed on the market, put into service, or used. Discontinue or redesign so the prohibited practice is removed.

controls.title: Risk management system
controls.description: Establish, document and maintain a continuous risk management system across the lifecycle.

controls.title: Data & data governance
controls.description: Training, validation and testing datasets meet quality criteria; examine for bias; ensure relevance and representativeness.

controls.title: Technical documentation
controls.description: Maintain Annex IV technical documentation demonstrating conformity, kept up to date.

controls.title: Record-keeping / logging
controls.description: Automatic recording of events (logs) over the system's lifetime to ensure traceability.

controls.title: Transparency & instructions for use
controls.description: Design for sufficient transparency; provide clear instructions for use to deployers.

controls.title: Human oversight
controls.description: Design and document effective human oversight measures (including the ability to intervene or stop the system).

controls.title: Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity
controls.description: Achieve and monitor appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity; declare accuracy metrics.

controls.title: Quality management system
controls.description: Providers must operate a documented quality management system.

controls.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment (deployers)
controls.description: Certain deployers must perform and document a fundamental rights impact assessment before use.

controls.title: EU database registration
controls.description: Register the high-risk system (or its deployment, for public authorities) in the EU database.

controls.title: Post-market monitoring
controls.description: Establish a post-market monitoring plan and report serious incidents.

controls.title: AI interaction disclosure
controls.description: Inform natural persons that they are interacting with an AI system, unless obvious from context.

controls.title: Synthetic content marking
controls.description: Mark AI-generated or manipulated audio/image/video/text as artificially generated in a machine-readable way.

controls.title: Deepfake / content disclosure
controls.description: Disclose deepfakes and, for public-interest text, that content is AI-generated.

controls.title: Voluntary code of conduct
controls.description: Consider adhering to voluntary codes of conduct and internal AI policy even where no mandatory obligation applies.
